shell.brandLanding.aiLine: Either way the AI guides, and the work stays yours.
shell.brandLanding.oursText: Windmill’s own AI is built in, and a free account includes some of it each month. Windmill One raises the ceiling for one price. It is not on sale yet.
shell.brandLanding.runs: Web: Roadmap, Gym and Journal. The phone apps are in beta and not public yet.
shell.brandLanding.yoursText: Connect the assistant you already have to Roadmap and Gym. It asks for the access it needs, and you approve it.

shell.feedback.label: Feedback
shell.feedback.lede: Tell us what's working or what's broken — it goes straight to the team.

shell.feedback.title: Send feedback
shell.landingHead.description: Windmill is where a person keeps growing in body, skill and mind. An AI-native workout log, skill tree and journal. Use your own AI or ours.
shell.landingHead.heading: Windmill is where a person keeps growing {break}in body, skill and mind.
shell.landingHead.imageAlt: A hand-drawn RPG skill tree on a cream background with terracotta, gold, and sky nodes, the Windmill wordmark, and the tagline “Any goal, as a skill tree.”
shell.landingHead.stance: The AI guides. The work stays yours. Use your own AI or ours.
shell.landingHead.title: Windmill — a skill tree, a workout log and a journal
shell.landingHead.what: An AI-native workout log, skill tree and journal.

shell.signIn.oneDoor: New here? Same door — your account is created the first time.
shell.signIn.rateLimitedBody: Check your spam folder first — or try again in 10 minutes.
shell.signIn.rateLimitedTitle: That's a few links in a row
shell.signIn.reassurance: No password. Whatever you have already made on this device is claimed when you sign in — and some rooms only open once you have an account.
shell.signIn.sent: We sent a link to {email}. It works once and lasts 15 minutes.
shell.signIn.typo: That address looks unfinished — check the ending.
shell.signIn.unreachableBody: Nothing on this device was touched — try again in a moment.
shell.site.description: Three self-growth tools on one account — Roadmap turns any goal into a living RPG skill tree, Journal is free-form daily writing that finds the feeling rather than the word, and Gym is a quiet workout log.
shell.site.shareCardAlt: The Windmill share card — a hand-drawn skill tree on a cream background with terracotta, gold, and sky nodes, and the Windmill wordmark.
